schedule.label: Last team to lose its undefeated record
schedule.rule: If teams lose their last unbeaten game in the same week, the tied teams keep going until one loses and the other does not; the one that does not lose wins.

winners.txt: last team to lose its undefeated record

schedule.label: Week 1: highest score
schedule.rule: Tie-breaker: the team with the highest-scoring player.

schedule.label: Week 2: highest-scoring starter who is not a QB
Week 4: most touchdowns by the starting lineup
schedule.rule: Passing touchdowns count. A tie-breaker extends to the next week. Enter the winner in manualWinners.

schedule.label: Week 5: beat the highest-scoring losing team
schedule.rule: The prize goes to the team that beat the team with the highest score among that week's losers.

schedule.label: After week 7: 1st place in the standings
Week 8: biggest blowout
schedule.rule: The winner of the largest margin of victory.

schedule.label: End of week 14: team of the top-scoring non-QB player of the season
schedule.rule: The player with the most points on the season (not a QB); the prize goes to the team that has him.

schedule.label: End of week 14: beat the best-ranked loser of the week
schedule.rule: The prize goes to the team that beat the highest-ranked (by regular-season standings) team that lost in week 14.
